prediction.sql: WITH female_client AS (SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id AS residence_district_id, d.A2 AS residence_district FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29'), client_accounts AS (SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id AS account_district_id, a.date AS account_open_date, fc.residence_district_id, fc.residence_district FROM female_client AS fc JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.client_id = fc.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id), account_transactions AS (SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense, MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance FROM trans AS t WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id), loan_counts AS (SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM loan AS l GROUP BY l.account_id), card_counts AS (SELECT dp.account_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count FROM card AS cd JOIN disp AS dp ON cd.disp_id = dp.disp_id GROUP BY dp.account_id) SELECT ca.residence_district AS residence_district, d.A2 AS account_district, CASE WHEN ca.residence_district = d.A2 THEN 'Same as residence' ELSE 'Different from residence' END AS district_comparison, ca.account_open_date AS account_open_date, COALESCE(at.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count, COALESCE(at.total_income, 0) AS total_income, COALESCE(at.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense, COALESCE(at.max_balance, 0) AS max_balance, COALESCE(lc.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count, COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0) AS card_count, d.A3 AS region, d.A10 AS urban_ratio, d.A11 AS avg_salary, d.A14 AS entrepreneurs_per_1000 FROM client_accounts AS ca JOIN district AS d ON ca.account_district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN account_transactions AS at ON ca.account_id = at.account_id LEFT JOIN loan_counts AS lc ON ca.account_id = lc.account_id LEFT JOIN card_counts AS cc ON ca.account_id = cc.account_id ORDER BY ca.account_open_date
